page.content:
Discount-ticket booth under the red glass steps in Duffy Square.

How TKTS connects

  • Location: Times Square — The TKTS booth stands in Duffy Square at Times Square.
  • Topic: Broadway — TKTS sells same-day seats that feed Broadway houses.

What is TKTS?

TKTS is the Theatre Development Fund booth in Times Square that sells same-day seats, the red-step landmark that funnels walk-up audiences into Broadway houses.

Key threads lead to Times Square and Broadway.
